messages:
marta-payroll: Heads up 1: Olivia (Data Eng) submitted resignation yesterday; last day 2026-06-11. We need COBRA packet timing, final pay run alignment, access deprovision plan, and asset return flow.

liam_it: Thanks. Typical plan: disable interactive Okta at start of last day, revoke API tokens EOD, and collect device via pre-paid shipping. Any deviations?

sara_manager: We want Olivia available for a short knowledge transfer afternoon session on her last day. Please schedule disable at 18:00 instead of morning.

marta-payroll: Final payroll is 2026-06-18. Health coverage remains through 6/11. COBRA notice should be issued 6/12 by broker. Olivia please confirm mailing address and any dependents for the COBRA packet.

olivia: Confirmed home address in Marin. No dependents. I can hand off laptop to courier on 6/12 morning if easier.

liam_it: I'll create IT ticket and asset label. Deprovision checklist I'll follow: revoke Okta, GitHub removal after repo transfer, AWS key rotation, Slack disable, reclaim laptop.

it-bot: [automated] IT ticket IT-7722 created and assigned to liam_it. Asset label AR-7110 generated.

marta-payroll: Broker also sends email and postal; please confirm address quickly so mail goes to the right place.

sara_manager: I'll coordinate the transfer doc and ensure someone owns each service. Jenna recruiting (not in thread) to pause outreach until we finalize JD edits.

liam_it: Will post exact deprovision window once Olivia confirms final handoff timing. Tentative: 2026-06-11 18:00 disable, 23:59 revoke keys.

marta-payroll: I'll DM Olivia the COBRA FAQ and election timeline.

olivia: Thanks all 1. Appreciate the smooth process.
